page.content:
Upper Egyptian capital of Amun's great temples.

How Thebes connects

  • Location: Karnak — Karnak stands in Thebes.
  • Location: Valley of the Kings — The Valley of the Kings is on Thebes' west bank.
  • Character: Hathor — Hathor greets the Theban dead on the western mountain.

What is Thebes?

Thebes — Waset — was the New Kingdom religious capital, home of Karnak and Luxor, and the west-bank necropolis that faces the valley of the kings.

Key threads lead to Karnak, Valley of the Kings and Hathor.
